verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack says whether Fathom uses meeting data to train AI models. It also documents no org-level training opt-out and no SOC 2 or HIPAA posture. The closest items are SSO & SCIM provisioning and admin view permissions, which are adjacent admin controls and do not address this story. The axis clearly applies to an AI meeting recorder, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
